# FTIDensity

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FTI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FTI/FTIDensity`

Manual: [FTIDensity (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/FTIDensity.md)

```text
FTIDensity, version 0.01

Usage: FTIDensity [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --ground-file : name of the file corresponding to the ground state of the whole system
    --degenerated-groundstate : single column file describing a degenerated ground state
    --left-states : single column file describing a degenerated ground state for the bra (aka laft states of the expectation values), should be used with --off-diagonal
    --off-diagonal : use --degenerated-groundstate as a list of states and compute all the cross density terms
    --show-time : show time required for each operation
    -s, --nbr-subbands : number of subbands (default value = 1)
    --decoupled : assume that the FTI states are made of two decoupled FCI copies
    --sigma : in decoupled mode, only compute in a given spin/sigma sector if non-negative (default value = -1)
    --time-reversal : apply complex conjugation to the left state before computing expectation values
    --3d : consider a 3d model instead of a 2d model
    --Wannier : Wannier basis
    --rhorho : also compute the density-density expectation values
    --intraband-only : when computing the density-density expectation values, only consider the intra band terms
    --allowed-orbitals : provide an ASCII file indicating which orbitals are allowed

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (replacing the vec extension with rho.dat extension

precalculation options:
    --hilbert-only : only compte the Hilbert spaces, bypassing the diagonalization

tools options:
    --use-lapack : use LAPACK libraries instead of DiagHam libraries

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
